This function uses a small state\n316\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n317\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n318\t/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n319\t/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n320\t/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n321\t///\n322\t/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n323\t/// statement terminators.\n324\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n325\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n326\t    let len = bytes.len();\n327\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n328\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n329\t    let mut i = 0;\n330\t\n331\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n332\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n333\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n334\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n335\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n336\t\n337\t    while i < len {\n338\t        let b = bytes[i];\n339\t\n340\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n341\t        if in_line_comment {\n342\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n343\t                in_line_comment = false;\n344\t            }\n345\t            i += 1;\n346\t            continue;\n347\t        }\n348\t\n349\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n350\t        if in_block_comment {\n351\t            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n352\t                in_block_comment = false;\n353\t                i += 2;\n354\t            } else {\n355\t                i += 1;\n356\t            }\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n361\t        if in_single_quote {\n362\t 2;\n366\t                } else {\n367\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n368\t                    i += 1;\n369\t                }\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                i += 1;\n372\t            }\n373\t            continue;\n374\t        }\n375\t\n376\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n377\t        if in_double_quote {\n378\t            if b == b'\"' parsing ---\n392\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n393\t            in_single_quote = true;\n394\t            i += 1;\n395\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n396\t            in_double_quote = true;\n397\t < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n402\t            in_block_comment = true;\n403\t            i += 2;\n404\t        } else if b == b';' {\n405\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n406\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n407\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n408\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n409\t            }\n410\t            start = i + 1;\n411\t            i += 1;\n412\t        } else {\n413\t            i += 1;\n414\t        }\n415\t    }\n416\t\n417\t    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n418\t    if start < len {\n419\t        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n420\t        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n421\t            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n422\t        }\n423\t    }\n424\t\n425\t    stmts\n426\t}\n427\t\n428\t/// Execute Ok(())\n432\t}\n433\t\n434\tpub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n435\t    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n436\t    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n437\t let mut in_line_comment = false;\n    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n\n    while i < len {\n        let b = bytes[i];\n\n        // --- Line comment state ---\n        if in_line_comment {\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                in_line_comment = false;\n            }\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Block comment state ---\n        if in_block_comment {\n            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n                in_block_comment = false;\n                i += 2;\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n        if in_single_quote {\n            if b == b'\\'' {\n                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_single_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n        if in_double_quote {\n            if b == b'\"' {\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_double_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n        if b == b'\\'' {\n            in_single_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'\"' {\n            in_double_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n            in_line_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n            in_block_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b';' {\n            // Statement terminator at top level.\n            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n            }\n            start = i + 1;\n            i += 1;\n        } else {\n            i += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n    if start < len {\n        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    stmts\n}\n\n/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\nfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn apply_schema(conn: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n    let has_es: bool = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM  INSERT INTO critical_path_cache_new (bead_id, float, updated_at)\n                 SELECT bead_id, CAST(float AS INTEGER), updated_at FROM critical_path_cache;\n             DROP TABLE critical_path_cache;\n             ALTER TABLE critical_path_cache_new RENAME TO critical_path_cache;\n             COMMIT;\"\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Create indexes for critical_path_cache (idempotent)\n    let _ = conn.execute_batch(\n        \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_epic ON critical_path_cache(epic_id);\n         CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS TEXT\", [])?;\n    }\n\n    // Migration 3: Add closed_at and duration_seconds to worker_sessions for velocity tracking\n    let has_closed_at: bool = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE name='closed_at'\",\n        [],\n        |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n    ).unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_closed_at {\n        conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN closed_at DATETIME\", [])?;\n        conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN duration_seconds INTEGER\", [])?;\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn ensure_wal_mode(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Use execute_batch so PRAGMAs that return rows don't cause errors\n    conn.execute_batch(\n        \"PRAGMA    std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = beads_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        let metadata = r#\"{\"database\": type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type = Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let        out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n    println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n                         all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // serde_json::json!({\n                            \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                            \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                            \"assignee\": assignee\n                        });\n                        println!(\"{}\", output);\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            None => {\n                // Fallback to any workspace\n                let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                    find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n                } else {\n                    workspace_paths.to_vec()\n                };\n\n                let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee,                   println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_sync(beads_dir: &PathBuf, flush_only: bool, import_only: false;\n        }\n\n        // Compare comments (order independent)\n        let mut self_comments = self.comments.clone();\n        self_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        let mut other_comments = other.comments.clone();\n        other_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n            left.issue_id\n                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n        });\n        if self_comments != other_comments {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if this issue is a tombstone that has exceeded its TTL.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_expired_tombstone(&self, retention_days: Option<u64>) -> bool {\n        if self.status != Status::Tombstone {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        // Clamp days to a safe maximum to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n    }\n}\n\n/// Epic completion status with child counts.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct EpicStatus {\n    pub epic: Issue,\n    pub total_children: usize,\n    pub
